description: This file defines the Basket entity class within the domain model of an e-commerce application, including properties and methods to manage basket items, total calculation, and buyer identification.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: Represents a shopping basket/ cart for a buyer, manages basket items and related operations.

methods.name: Basket
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new Basket with a buyer ID.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the basket or increments the quantity if it already exists.

methods.name: RemoveEmptyItems
methods.description: Removes items with zero quantity from the basket.

methods.name: SetNewBuyerId
methods.description: Updates the buyer ID for the basket.
